input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic one-year (not multi-year) renewals, which is acceptable, and the Agreement contains no renewal price-uplift mechanic, so the pricing element of the rule is satisfied. However, the non-renewal notice window is ninety (90) days, which exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days (and the preferred 30 days), so the clause fails the fallback on a material term, though it stops short of walk-away territory. The redline moves the Company to a 30-day window while leaving HDI's 90-day period intact, so our exit flexibility improves without shortening the notice we receive; a 60-day Company window is an acceptable fallback. Note as a minor point only that there is no vendor renewal reminder mechanic.

proposal.summary: Shorten the Company's non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days (HDI's notice period unchanged).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened our non-renewal notice window from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days, since our playbook requires auto-renewals we can exit on 30 days' notice (60 days at most); HDI's notice period is left at 90 days so we retain continuity of service. We can accept 60 days for the Company if that is easier.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company.
